result.rationale: Exclude CheckSammy entirely, not only I Squared's period. I Squared's January 2024 growth equity is attributable to ISQ Global InfraTech Fund, L.P., which the manager defines as a proprietary growth-stage venture strategy and therefore fails the direct-infrastructure mandate test. CheckSammy is no longer purely asset-light: it still orchestrates independent haulers and software but now claims four owned-and-operated ZeroPoint hubs. ZIP, GLIN and Kensington's candidate exposure are venture/growth/impact; lenders are not equity.

identityResolution.finding: Canonical operator is CheckSammy Inc., a Delaware corporation headquartered in Dallas/Addison, Texas. CheckSammy Technologies, Inc. is its disclosed parent/legacy Canadian issuer, not a duplicate.

ownershipResolution.capitalAndStatus: The US$45 million 2024 package combined I Squared-led growth equity, ZIP participation and a TriplePoint revolver; split, valuation, stakes and control were undisclosed. TriplePoint was a lender. FirePower and PaceZero provided 2022 term debt; FirePower was repaid after the 2024 financing, while PaceZero's payoff is undisclosed. I Squared still lists CheckSammy under InfraTech and no equity exit was found.

result.operatingResolution: Hybrid managed marketplace/software plus four controlled ZeroPoint hubs that receive, weigh, sort, depackage, separate and aggregate materials for recycling partners. The September 2025 network exceeded 500,000 square feet, adding Indianapolis and Lakeland. Customers include retailers, manufacturers, 3PLs and other enterprises across the U.S., Canada, Mexico and Europe. No landfill ownership was found; property title versus leasehold is undisclosed. Operationally it meets the asset limb on its claims, but no disclosed investor meets the qualifying-mandate limb.

acquisitionExitCheck.laterFinancing: GLIN completed an investment on 2026-04-30; amount, security and stake were undisclosed.
acquisitionExitCheck.exitOrRecap: No acquisition, disclosed add-on, sale, recapitalization, equity exit or signed pending deal was found; FirePower debt was repaid after the 2024 round.
